description: This file contains unit tests for SwiftUI views using the XCTest framework. It defines a test suite 'SwiftUIRenderSmokeTests' that verifies the view hierarchy building for various UI components within an iOS app, using a custom hosting function.

classes.name: SwiftUIRenderSmokeTests
classes.description: A test suite containing smoke tests for verifying the construction of SwiftUI view hierarchies related to the OpenClaw app.

methods.name: host
methods.description: A private static method that hosts a SwiftUI view inside a UIWindow for testing purposes.

methods.description: Test verifying that a StatusPill with 'connecting' state builds its view hierarchy correctly.
